description: Versioned pricing record for POC 6c confirmation run cost accounting. Used by provider.py to compute provider_cost_usd from observed billable tokens only. Do not estimate missing values.
source_sha256_note: SHA-256 of https://www.anthropic.com/pricing fetched 2026-08-09T00:00:00Z (page last published 2026-08-06 21:48:02 UTC). Re-verify before any confirmation run by fetching the pricing page and comparing digest.
applicable_rate_note: Introductory rates apply through 2026-08-31. Standard rates apply from 2026-09-01. Re-lock before confirmation if running after 2026-08-31.
note: input_usd_per_million_tokens and output_usd_per_million_tokens reflect the currently applicable rate (introductory as of 2026-08-04). Standard rates are recorded separately.

models.notes: Pinned Sonnet-tier agent model per decision 2026-08-04. Introductory rate ($2/$10) active through 2026-08-31; standard rate ($3/$15) thereafter. Must verify via GET /v1/models at preflight. Re-lock applicable_rate before confirmation if date has passed.
Pinned Opus-tier blinded evaluator model per decision 2026-08-04. Must verify via GET /v1/models at preflight.

confirmation_constraints.rationale: For the first confirmation, these features are disabled so cost accounting uses only standard observed billable token categories (input_tokens, output_tokens) and locked rates above, producing unambiguous provider_cost_usd.
